topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Well, now, I heard the miller's lad say the ale for the great feast was all set, but it seems the very wheels of providence turned against us. I was naught but mending my plow when the village crier brought the tidings. A surprise, you said? But the sky, it didn’t promise rain, and the earth, well, it was as firm as the day I turned my first furrow. I reckon the saints must be watching closely. They know we all looked forward to a bit of laughter and a full belly. I'll keep watch over the fields, tend them with care, and perhaps, with their grace, we can still find a way to gather, even if it’s just under the old oak at sunset, with a shared loaf and a tale or two.
